message.content: Evaluation of underwater 3D geometry estimation is limited by the impractical need for large-scale, high-quality annotations. Existing benchmarks struggle to effectively assess real-world proactive agents. To overcome these limitations, researchers have developed annotation-free learning methods and universal evaluation benchmarks. Comparative studies of linear attention architectures provide systematic assessment of performance trade-offs.
